The HTC Jetstream is a 10.1 inch tablet from Taiwanese company HTC, which was earlier rumored as the HTC Puccini. It is also the first 4G LTE tablet from AT&T.[1]

HTC Jetstream has a 1.5 GHz dual core processor and an 8MP camera.[2]
